name: Tempester 1.6.1.0 — project request
summary: A computer can ask the machine for the whole project.

fixes: The 4 Pole and AD Mode LEDs follow a value set over MIDI (the sound already changed, the LED kept its old state).
additions: A request makes the machine send the whole project, exactly as the menu « Export Project over MIDI » does, on the cable chosen in System.

description: 1.6.0.0 plus n°25 (the Panel LEDs of 4 Pole and AD Mode follow a value set by NRPN) and n°24: the SysEx request F0 01 28 42 F7 sends the whole project (5E, then 5C n for each beat of the project), the bytes of the menu « Export Project over MIDI », on the cable set in System. Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
